abstract: In this paper, a novel event-triggered scheme resorting to a queue buffer is proposed for a class of networked control systems. Compared with some existing schemes, our scheme can save more communication and computation resource together with better control performance and reduce the conservativeness of the results. To match the novel scheme, a state feedback controller is also designed. Based on a Lyapunov functional method, criteria for the stability and the co-design of both the feedback gains and the trigger parameters are derived. Finally, a simulation example is proposed to illustrate the effectiveness of the developed method.

articleTitle: A Networked Control Scheme of Residential Microgrid for China Remote Areas
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: A set of complete residential microgrid (MG) control scheme for China remote areas is proposed in the paper. Firstly, a residential MG, which mainly includes distributed generation (DG), energy storage (ES), controllable load (CL), key load (KL), and control system, is proposed. Considering some communication security issues, main control systems including prediction system (PS), energy management system (EMS), and DGs control system are then introduced. By the above design, the residential MG can provide reliable electricity for local residents. Finally, simulations in MATLAB indicate the feasibility of proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Multiple Hypothesis Tracking based on Discriminative Appearance Features of Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: Multiple Object Tracking (MOT) has attracted increasing attention due to its academic and commercial potential. However, it still remains challenging due to factors like data association ambiguity and abrupt appearance changes. To address these issues, we extended the multiple hypothesis tracking (MHT) by incorporating the appearance features which extracted from faster region convolutional neural network (Faster-RCNN). Additionally, a principal component analysis method was introduced to update discriminative appearance features. Thus, the data association ambiguity can be reduced surprisingly by exploiting Faster-RCNN, which means fewer hypothesis for MHT. Meanwhile, the issue of abrupt appearance changes can be addressed by modeling discriminative appearance feature based-on MHT. Many experiments on MOT benchmark show competitive performance of the proposed approach in comparison with other state-of-art tracking methods.

articleTitle: Evaluation Model for Layout Rationality of Power Grid Business Halls Based on Analytic Hierarchy Process
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: Taking population, geographical environment and status of the power grid business halls as the starting point. We establish the layout rationality evaluation index system of power grid business halls by decomposing and refining the indicator factor layer by layer. The index system consists of 3 major elements and 16 factors. According to the layout rationality evaluation indicator system, the analytic hierarchy process is applied to construct the layout rationality evaluation model of power grid business halls. On the basis of expert consultation and field investigation, the layout rationality of the power grid business halls in Jiangxi and Chongqing was evaluated, and the layout rationality of power grid business halls in this area is defined as 4 levels. This study can provide strong theoretical and technical support for the layout optimization of power grid business halls.

articleTitle: Improved ICP Matching Algorithm Based on Laser Radar and IMU
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: In this paper, we proposed the improved iterative closest point algorithm based on laser radar and IMU. The system composition is described. The initial pose estimates of two scanning point clouds are obtained by IMU, and extraction of line feature of two 2-D point sets is put forward to accomplish the matching of fast changing scenario. The experiment is carried out, and the results show that the improved ICP algorithm could accelerate the iteration of ICP and improve the performance of point clouds.

articleTitle: Heart Rate Detection Based on Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: In order to measure heart rate remotely under daily scenes from face videos, this paper proposes a well-performing framework, which includes a regional strategy and KCF tracking algorithm. The former chooses regions with little noise and rich information for detection, and the latter keeps the consistency of ROIs. In addition, noises caused by light and other environmental changes are reduced by using a detrending algorithm. After that, temporal filters are used to further reduce noises caused during the process of measurement. In this paper, human face videos are collected under normal illumination, and the results are analysed quantitatively. The proposed method outperforms than other methods in accuracy and robustness.

articleTitle: A P2P Lending Agency Risk Evaluation Approach Based on RL
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: This paper proposes a P2P lending agency risk evaluation approach based on an improved RL model, which has rarely been studied before. The approach looks on the task of risk evaluation as a kind of text categorization. In order to solve the problem of small-scale data and data imbalance of P2P agencies for text categorization using existed supervised learning methods, this paper adopts the RL model. Unfortunately, existed RL models are usually time-consuming. Hence this paper continues to put forward an improved RL model to dynamically update sample weights so as to speed up the training of the model. Experimental results have shown that our proposed model is less affected by data imbalance and has good performance compared with other models.

articleTitle: Probability-constrained Filtering for Linear System with Successive Packet Dropouts and Multiplicative Noises
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: This paper focus on the probability-constrained filtering problem for a class of time-varying systems with successive packet dropouts and multiplicative noises. The purpose of this paper is to design a time-varying filter guaranteeing the probabilities of the estimation error are larger than a prescribed constant. Additionally the given ellipsoidal set is minimized at each time point. To achieve the probabilistic constraint objective, the probabilistic constraint is replaced by a multi-dimensional Chebyshev bound. By using a stochastic analysis method, sufficient conditions in terms of recursive matrix inequalities are established for the existence of the probability constrained filter. Then a algorithm is proposed to obtain the optimal filterand minimize the ellipsoid. Finally, a simulation example is proposed to illustrate the effectiveness and applicability of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: TIER: A Novel Model Based on POS Information to Generate Dialogue
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: The design of dialogue system which interacts with users in natural language ranks high on the agenda of current NLP research. A well-performed dialogue system should generate responses that are not only diverse and meaningful but also grammatically correct. Although the former gives a rise to a research hotspot, the latter hasn’t gotten as much attention. In this paper, we proposed POS-aided model called tag guided encoder-decoder, which takes not only word sequence but also POS tag sequence as inputs. By introducing POS tags, the model can operate on part-of-speech information implicitly, and thus gains the syntactic guidance to generate grammatical responses. In our experiment, we apply the model to dialogue response generation in the open-domain and compare it with competing models. The results show that our model outperforms the competing model according to BLEU metric and human evaluation study.

articleTitle: H∞ Robust Optimal Control of Variable Period NCS with Uncertain Delay and Packet Loss
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: For a class of network control system with uncertain time delay, packet loss, variable sampling period and the external disturbance. Using LMI and Lyapunov method to research robust H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> optimal control based on dynamic output feedback. Giving sufficient conditions for the system’s progressive stability and the existence of dynamic output feedback controller. Finally, the design method of optimal H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> control rate is given by solving optimization problem, and using LMI toolbox to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Adaptive Conversation System Based on Script : First Work:Construct Script with Vector and Classify it with SIFT
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: Our work is about conversation system based on script, supposing to design an adaptive agent. Purpose of this paper is to verify our idea of the transforming from text to image, and to implement an approach to find a new way of feature characterization on conversation text for our system. With sent2vec and SIFT, we designed a way of expression of text features and conducted experiments to classify conversation situations as Image Processing. Good results in close tests and bad results in open tests indicate the necessity of further work on our idea and the insignificance of the new feature characterization.

articleTitle: Emotion recognition for Twitter language based on lingual and expressional information
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: There have been many sentence-based and dictionary-based emotional corpora in the study of textual emotion recognition. However, many new expressive symbols, which we call the “facemarks”, have been observed in the social network language with the development of social network services (SNS). And studying the emotion expressions with these facemarks has been a new challenge yet a chance for emotion recognition in the social network. In this paper, we present our work on a study of emotion recognition for the Twitter language, by constructing a Twitter corpus with various kinds of facemarks in Tweets and evaluating the emotion expressions in these expressive symbols. By a parallel experiment of the emotion recognition based on the lingual and expressive features, we find that the expressive information has a decisive function in the recognition of Twitter language emotions.

articleTitle: Research on the Impact of Wind Power Generation with Energy Storage System on Grid Frequency Stability
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: In recent years, wind power generation has been developed rapidly. Strong random and weak controllability of wind power makes wind power generation output uncontrollable. The energy storage device has a good active dynamic response performance, and its rapid output change capacity can support power system frequency stability. This paper proposes a wind power-storage system coordinated control method to improve frequency stability.

articleTitle: Finite-Time Consensus for Discontinuous Multi-Agent Systems over Switching Topology
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: This paper considered with the finite-time consensus for multi-agent systems (MASs) with discontinuous dynamics over switching topology. A novel discontinuous control protocol is designed to achieved the finite-time consensus. Then, together with Lyapunov function method and finite-time stability theory, several sufficient conditions are derived to guarantee the MASs networks to be finite-time consensus. Moreover, an upper bound of the settling time can be theoretically estimated.

articleTitle: Research of MapReduce architecture on busbar protection
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: In order to solve the poor performance of busbar protection for outdoor installation, a distributed design method based on MapReduce architecture is introduced. The distributed busbar protection sub-machine which connects with HSR ring is divided into the scheduling node and the task node. The differential protection module of busbar protection is allocated some nodes to compute and merge according to the number of sub-machines, then the backup protection related to each sub-machine is assigned to the corresponding sub-machine and some redundant computing sub-machines, this design completes the busbar protection distributed computation and logical judgement, and the protection trip uses the `action three take two' logic. Through RTDS test, this design has proven to be reliable and improve the available resources and performance of the busbar protection.

articleTitle: Mining the Usage of Summary Oriented Features in Abstractive Summarization
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a textual feature representation method used in seq2seq model to generate an abstractive summary for a Chinese natural language short text. Word embedding is the main feature applied in current seq2seq model while generating abstractive summary, which describes the relation of different words from the perspective of semantics. However, word embedding fails to capture some specific word information of topic, position, POS, and etc. These features are very important for summary generation. Therefore, based on using word embedding as main word characteristic representation, we propose to add extra summary oriented features to construct a more powerful denotation. We have studied 6 summary oriented word features, i.e. position, POS, NER, frequency, topic and hierarchical feature of hLDA. Experiments on the corpus of LCSTS have proven the validity of newly introduced summary oriented features in abstractive summarization.

articleTitle: Event-based resilient H∞ fuzzy filter design under DoS attacks
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: This paper is concerned with the problem of event-triggered T-S fuzzy filter design under DoS attacks. Concept of average dwell time is used to characterize DoS attacks behaviors in duration and frequency. Integrating event-triggered mechanism, filter error dynamic is modeled by switched time varying delay fuzzy system. Then, time delay method and switched system theory are employed to analysis H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> performance of filter error dynamic. Sufficient conditions are derived by satisfying which filer error system is exponential stability with H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> disturbance attenuant. Finally, design method of filter parameters is given by solving related LMIs.

articleTitle: Non-Task Dialogue System Enriched with Knowledge
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: Sequence-to-sequence model-based dialogue systems suffer from tending to generate safe, commonplace and passive responses. In this paper, we enrich the information of responses by incorporating external structured knowledge to the dialogue system. To this end, this paper extends the standard attention-based sequence-to-sequence model with knowledge-based attention and candidate target entities prediction. Moreover, a hierarchical recurrent neural network is proposed to improve the encoding of complex dialogue history. Experiments demonstrate that chatbot with prior knowledge greatly improves the responses in both quality and quantity, and in particular, achieves some degree of initiative by indirectly guiding the direction of dialogue.

articleTitle: Smoothing Neural Network for Robust Sparse Signal Recovery
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: For the problem of robust sparse signal recovery in the field of compressed sensing, this work probes into its optimization model design and one related neural network. A constrained l<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>-norm minimization model is used to characterize the sparsity of its solution, while being further transformed into a nonsmooth nonconvex but continuous approximation model by using transformed l<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>-norm function instead of the l<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>-norm. To acquire the sparsest solution and satisfy the requirement of real-time processing, a smoothing approximation-based neural network is developed based on the penalty method. The existence, uniqueness and limit behavior of its solutions are well studied. Numerical results have validated that the neural network performs well over the compared approaches for recovering a sparse signal from noisy measurements.

articleTitle: A Robust Multi-Pedestrians Tracker Based on the Improved MDP Strategy
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: Multi-pedestrians tracking(MPT) has always been a hot topic in the field of machine vision. In order to find a tracker that is more suitable for practical complex scenes, we propose a robust tracker that fuses Gaussian filter with the MDP tracker and adds texture features to the original features. We added the detection weights and aspect ratios of the candidate boxes, which improves the drift of the tracking results. In order to further alleviate the data association problem when the object image is out, a method of checking whether the object exceeds the image is performed multiple frames. The experimental results on the MOT Challenge 2015 show that improved algorithm is more robust than the original algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Rapid Response and Regulation Model of Household User Load Group
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: Intelligent power technology is one of the technical means to realize smart grid. With the intelligence of household appliances, the arrangement of intelligent household appliances has become an important research content. By dividing the power consumption time into time periods, the starting time, the length of the electricity consumption, and the number of time periods used for each smart home appliance are expressed. According to the characteristics of intelligent household appliances, two models of interruptible and uninterruptible power consumption are proposed. According to the purpose of users’ electricity consumption, an optimal model of power arrangement for intelligent household appliances is proposed, which takes into account the influence of electricity consumption cost and power interruption on the users’ perception of electricity consumption at the same time. The simulation results show that the optimization method can be used to optimize intelligent household appliances reasonably. The use of electricity can effectively reduce the cost of electricity consumption and reduce the peak value of electricity. The allowable interruption times of the electrical equipment are allowed to affect the cost of electricity consumption and the distribution of electricity time.

articleTitle: Cloud Storage Behavior Analysis Using Time Series Clustering
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: To meet with different storage requirements, lots of products are provided by cloud service providers. These products vary greatly in price and performance. Choosing different storage services to build tiered storage systems could reduce overall costs of using of cloud services. But choosing of storage services is not easy because it must meet storage performance requirements and minimize the costs. We use machine leaning methods to solve this problem. Log files that keep storage access traits are used to analyze storage access patterns. Firstly, we process log files and generate access frequency time series, which are translated to N-Hot time series later. Then we extract feathers from N-Hot time series and use K-Means clustering method to classify storage objects. Different migration policies could be made to optimize storage usages according to these different classes of storage objects. The experiments show that our approach is useful, well performance and scalable.

articleTitle: Consensus of Multi-agent Systems with Relative State Saturations
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: In a classical consensus problem, the relative sates between neighbors play an important role in designing distributed protocols. In practice, these relative states are measured by some on-board sensors, and then the relative state saturations inevitably occur because of the limited sensing capabilities. This paper considers the consensus problem of nonlinear multi-agent systems subject to the relative state saturations. Utilizing the incidence matrix and the edge Laplacian, the consensus of nonlinear multi-agent systems with the relative state saturations can be cast into the stabilization of edge dynamics confined into the constrained set. The state feedback protocol is proposed here for achieving the constrained consensus. A simulation example validates the effectiveness of our results.

articleTitle: FMS Modeling and Simulation Analysis Based on OOECTPN
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: To solve the problem that the object-oriented Petri net model has no time constraints and type constraints and cannot quantitatively analyze the system, the representation and reasoning of time knowledge is introduced into the object-oriented Petri net. An object-oriented extended coloring time Petri net is proposed. The object-oriented extended coloring time Petri net model of flexible manufacturing system is built, the analysis method of time consistency is given, the accessibility of the model is analyzed by using the correlation matrix, the time characteristic of the flexible manufacturing system is quantitatively analyzed, and the effectiveness of the modeling method is validated.

Author Keywords: Object-Oriented Extended Colored Timed Petri Nets (OOECTPN)

articleTitle: Evolutionary Prediction of Information Propagation Dynamics Based on Time Series Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: Using online social network has become increasingly popular among the general public for sharing information and rapid spreading information in recent years. Evolution prediction of information propagation has started to post its significance for enterprise marketing, public opinion monitoring, and personalized recommendation. This paper proposes a time series characteristics-based prediction method of information propagation (TSPIP), which combines the structural characteristics of microblog community and the data association mining rules of multiple time series. Firstly, non-stationary time series of microblog hot events are detected and transformed into event propagation sequences and stationary event propagation sequences. Secondly, a linear regression model is used to establish the quantitative relationship between the quantity of data and the explanatory variables. The best explanatory variables are selected by analysing correlation coefficient and the hypothesis test. Finally, a time series prediction model of microblog hot events is constructed according to the state space model of Local Linear Trend and Regression. Time series analysis is conducted to get the characteristics of event development trend and cycle. Experiments on real datasets show that our prediction method is effective for the propagation of microblog hot events with respect to burst traffic.

articleTitle: A Random Forest Concentration Detection Model for Short Video
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: The detection of concentration is widely used in the fields of education, advertising, and fatigue driving. In order to improve the objectivity, convenience and accuracy of concentration detection, this paper proposes a scheme for using machine learning to detect the concentration of short video. In this scheme, since the eye movement features are used as the basis for the judgment, the detection is convenient. For different types of eye movement data, we use feature selection methods such as logistic regression, wavelet decomposition and approximate entropy, and finally create new combined feature. The combined feature which take into account both eye movement event information and original eye movement information has a strong discrimination. Through research and compare, it is found that after the labeled training based on the questionnaire results, the concentration prediction model established by the combined feature and the random forest algorithm can make the average accuracy of the detection reach 95.52%.

articleTitle: Parameter Identification of Norton Equivalent Model from Harmonic Monitoring Data
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: A method of identifying the operating parameters of harmonic customers based on historical monitoring data is introduced in this paper. Firstly, PCA is used to reduce the original harmonic data dimensions and determine the appropriate number of clusters. Then k-means is used to partition harmonic mode on low dimensions. Lastly group feature parameters are calculated from the clustered typical harmonic operating conditions. Experimental results showed that the operating parameters of harmonic customers can be identified from a large number of high-dimensional historical statistic data by the proposed method, which will also contribute to the harmonic source location and optimal operation strategy.

articleTitle: Principle and Experimental Verification of a Novel Method: Tree Biomechanical Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: This paper presents the basic principle and experimenting of a novel method called tree biomechanical optimization. The uniqueness of search strategies of this method is based on biomechanics phenomena exist in trees. Whereby, the mass of growth in a tree is used to perturb the solution, in addition, the diversification is performed by using bending moment constraints. Furthermore, deviation of solution from the best to the worst is also used to enhance search process. Finally, experiments are carried out on quadratic assignment problems which are known to be NP-hard, and then, comparative analysis is performed between the results obtained by the proposed method and its rivals. Consequently, the performance of the new method is better or comparable to the other state-of-the-arts algorithms.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Decision of Drug Dosage for Type-1 Human Immunodeficiency Virus Infected Patients
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: The research subject of fuzzy decision of drug dosage for type-1 human immunodeficiency virus(HIV-1) infected patients is discussed by the aid of a existing fuzzy dynamic HIV-1 model. Firstly, by making use of the previous fuzzy modeling method, that intractable nonlinear predator-prey like model is converted to a set of tractable linear sub-models. Then, based on the above tractable sub-models and a kind of sampled-data fuzzy control strategy with a set of decay factors, all the dynamic properties of the fuzzy dynamic HIV-1 model can be acquired by means of high-performance computer simulations. Thirdly, some fuzzy decisions of drug dosage for HIV-1 infected patients are reasoned by consulting the computer simulation results and thus a bank of instructional advices are suggested for clinic care. Finally, some conclusions and future study directions are specifically discussed in the conclusion part.

articleTitle: Language Independent Entity Linking
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: Entity linking is the task of determining the identity of entities mentioned in text with entities in an existed database. Most previous Entity Linking research required training data with applied on a target language, while training data may be costing on some languages. In the paper, we purposed a language independent entity linking system, which can be trained on one language and performs well on different other languages without change. The purposed system realize the entity linking based on different kinds of language independent features and a discriminative ranking function. Experiments on different datasets show that the proposed system once trained on one language performs well on other languages.

articleTitle: The Physical Layer Network Coding System with Adaptive Pre-equalization and Decode-Forward Transform
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: In this paper, we build a physical layer network coding (PLNC) system with adaptive pre-equalization and decode-forward transform. First, adaptive equalizers are designed at the transmitters (Alice and Bob) to compensate the distortion of channels, where pre-equalization and post-equalization share the same equalizer coefficients. The coefficients are adjusted adaptively with channels by zero forcing (ZF) criterions. The decode-forward (DF) mode is adopted at Relay to improve the system performance furtherly. Simulation results show that the superiority of the joint employment of adaptive pre-equalization and the DF mode.

articleTitle: Planning of Distribution Network with Electric Vehicle Charging Stations
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: With the popularization and application of electric vehicles, the planning of electric vehicles charging stations is getting more and more attention. In this paper, a distribution network planning model considering economic and user unsatisfactory value is proposed. Firstly, the load of electric vehicle is analyzed and calculated. On this basis, a user dissatisfaction model is established to evaluate the planning of the electric vehicle charging station. Finally, the distribution network planning model is proposed. The objects of the model is the economic cost of the distribution network and the unsatisfactory value of the users. The improved particle swarm optimization algorithm is applied to solve this model. Based on the simulation of the modified IEEE33 example and the analysis of the results, the validity and superiority of the model is verified, which provides a idea for the planning of distribution network with electric vehicle charging station.

articleTitle: Dynamically Exchanging Nodes of the Critical Node Problem
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: The Critical Node Problem (CNP) aims to identify k nodes from an undirected graph G=(V,E), in order to minimize the number of pairwise connected nodes in the residual graph after deleting these k nodes. This problem has a wide range of applications in the fields of cyber security, disease control, biological analysis, social network, etc. The CNP is known to be NP-hard, and heuristics are commonly used to solve large-scale CNP instances, among which the node-exchange operation is a basic move operator widely adopted by local-search based heuristics. Given an initial CNP solution consisting of k nodes, there are totally k×(|V|−k) possible node-exchange operations. The current best algorithm requires a complexity of O((|V|−k)×(|V|+|E|+k×D(G))) to evaluate all these operations (|V| denotes the number of nodes, |E| denotes the number of edges, D(G) denotes the maximum degree of the node in graph G).In this paper, a series of dynamic data structures are implemented to reduce the above complexity to O((|V|−k)×(|V|+|E|)), so as to improve the efficiency of local search.

articleTitle: An Adaptive WKNN Outdoor Location Methodology Based on OTT and MR Data
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: Outdoor location is an important concern for mobile carriers to optimize wireless telecom network and coverage. When GPS information is not fully available, techniques such as fingerprinting can be developed to retrieve positioning. In this article, a novel fingerprint algorithm based on WKNN is proposed. This algorithm introduces additional weights computed with random forests and based on importance of each feature collected via measurement report. It also makes adaptive selection of reference points by discarding untrustworthy ones in order to refine precision of each user equipment positioning prediction. The whole methodology is implemented with Apache Spark framework and tested on real data flow from a major Chinese telecom carrier. Results show significant improvement of the methodology compared to both TA+AOA and classic WKNN fingerprinting methods.

articleTitle: The Implementable Assessment of System Protection Controllable Resource Pool Policy
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of grid security and stability caused by DC faults in the Northwest Power Grid, the system protection and control resource pool strategy is adopted to ensure the safe and stable operation of the grid. Based on the storage and processing of power network data, this paper proposes the implementable assessment of the system protection controllable resource pool strategy. It includes the establishment of the expected fault set and the offline policy table, the implementable assessment of the system protection controllable resource pool strategy, and the research of the system protection action alarm.

articleTitle: Improving RETECS method using FP-Growth in continuous integration
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: Continuous integration is an important but time and resource consuming process. Testing should be continuously done during this period. Developers need to select and refine test case as soon as possible to reduce testing cost. However, testing in continuous integration frequently is prohibitively expensive. To address this issue, we improve RETECS method using FP-Growth algorithm. The relationship of test case is identified by FP-Growth, a frequent pattern mining algorithm. Test cases are reprioritized using adjusting rule formed by FP-Growth algorithm. Our test case reprioritization is based on history testing data and prioritization by RETECS method. The laboratory results express that our approach can improve fault detection ratio compared to RETECS method.

articleTitle: Information and Communication Networks Security Protection Under Complex Networks Citcumstance
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: In the information and communication networks, each internal functional unit establishes a functional relationship through information exchange to form a complex networks system. From the perspective of complex networks theory, analyzing the network structure of information and communication system has profound practical significance for deepening the construction of information and communication network and security protection. Using Matlab to simulate the process of attacking information and communication network, it can be concluded that networks which are deliberately attacked paralyze much faster than those which are randomly attacked. Therefore, there are some key communication nodes in large complex networks which should be especially focused on. Correspondingly, some targeted protective measures can be taken to improve the security of the information and communication networks. The measures are as follows: to strengthen the protection of the core nodes, to enhance disaster recovery capabilities, to achieve diversity and accessibility of information communication, to use multilevel network protection, and to develop rapid recovery network repair capabilities.

articleTitle: Multiple Convolutional Neural Networks for Online Visual Tracking
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: The paper presents a new online visual tracking method based on convolutional neural network (CNN). Our algorithm consists of multiple CNN tracker units focusing on different object features, and each unit is trained with a proper number of domains determined by our method. For the model update process, traditional CNN online re-training is avoided, replaced by a timely tracker switching strategy. At each moment, only one main tracker predicts and others stand by to ensure efficiency. The experimental results show that our method can track objects in most scenarios, and implicate that our CNN model has a generalization ability in distinguishing target and background.

articleTitle: A Two-Layer Genetic Algorithm Based on Matrix Coding for FJSP
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: To solve the problem of large number of redundant search existing in traditional genetic algorithm for solving Flexible Job Shop Scheduling Problem (FJSP), a two-layer genetic algorithm based on matrix coding for FJSP was proposed. The algorithm used double matrix structure to encode which included machine selection matrix and operation sorting matrix. Outer genetic algorithm is used to search for the best option of machine selection, which transform FJSP to JSP. Inner genetic algorithm is used to solve the sub-problem of JSP based on machine selection matrix. The effectiveness of proposed algorithm was verified by analyzing the results of benchmarks.

articleTitle: Research on the Internet of Things Platform for Smart and Environmental Protection
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: This article focuses on the research and implementation of an intelligent environmentally IoT platform and intelligently connects traditional environmental protection devices to the IoT Cloud platform. There are different types of environmental protection equipment, such as PM2.5, Pm10, water, sound and gas monitoring equipment. In this paper the environmental protection equipments connect to the IoT cloud platform through the smart gateway, and the communication mode of the network include 2G,3G,4G, Narrowband-IoT. The management platform supports intelligent access to devices, remote management, real-time monitoring and data analysis, prediction alarm. The vision of the Internet of Things (IoT) is a dynamic global network based on standard and interoperable communication protocols where physical and virtual things have identities, physical attributes, and capabilities and are seamlessly integrated into the existing internet infrastructure. This paper descripes the intelligent environment project which is based on Smart Environmental Gateway Management Platform. It's function position is to build a smart environmentally aware network of omni-directional interconnections between the environment and society and to realize the modernization and intelligence of environmental monitoring and control The experimental results show that the IoT platform is stable, scalable, high performance.

articleTitle: Hierarchical Control of Microgrid with Multi Distributed Generations
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: With the gradual penetration of distributed generation (DG), the concept of microgrid is developing more and more. Hierarchical control is considered to be the most effective method for microgrid control. In this paper, a two level microgrid control method is proposed based on hierarchical control. The first level control adopts droop control and voltage and current control. The second level control is used to repair the frequency and voltage deviation caused by the first level control. Finally, through the Matlab/Simulink simulation platform, the power sharing, voltage and frequency of each distributed generation in the operation process, as well as the dynamic operation of the microgrid in the case of sudden increase and reduction of load are analyzed, and the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified.

articleTitle: Improved Fuzzy K-means Clustering Based on Imbalanced Measure of Cluster Sizes
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: Fuzzy k-means (FKM) algorithm is an extension of the K-means algorithm, which improves the clustering accuracy of the K-means algorithm for overlapping data sets. However, it has a poor clustering performance for imbalanced datasets. In order to cope with this issue, a measuring method with imbalanced cluster size is introduced. An improved fuzzy k-means algorithm based on imbalanced measure of cluster size is further proposed, by which the imbalanced datasets can be directly processed at the algorithm level. Experimental results on synthetic and UCI datasets showed that the proposed method has better clustering performance than traditional FKM algorithm in case of that there are imbalanced clusters.

articleTitle: Object Recognition and Simultaneous Indoor Localization Algorithm with Stereo Camera
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: Indoor position technology based on visual becames a hot spot which can provide high position accuracy and more scene information. The system proposed by this paper is operated in real time, robust to severe motion clutter and brightness transformation and low cost which combines several steps include image acquisition and correction, object recognition based on deep learning and stereo matching. And this paper also proposes a new multi-feature fusion feature point extraction and matching algorithm for object accurate location. Finally, we present an evaluation in the dynamic indoor positioning tests and the result of the indoor horizontal positioning error is less than 1m.

articleTitle: Optimization of core muscle strength prescription based on improved PSO-BP neural network
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: The MKXL-B core muscle strength training system is a set of medical equipment which relieve or cure common low back pain in patients. The prescription design of traditional muscle strength training medical device is usually based on the patient's physical condition and the expert's own experience. Due to the patient's own particularity and other reasons, the expert's prescription may not be suitable for the training of the patients. The expert will comprehensively evaluate the patient's condition to design the parameters of the prescription. This process is a waste of time and consumes medical resources. In view of the above problems, this paper presents an optimization algorithm based on improved particle swarm optimization and BP neural network. The error back propagation(BP) algorithm is used to realize the non-linear relationship [1]among prescription parameters. However, the BP algorithm has the disadvantage, which being trapped in local minimum. In order to solve this problem, an improved particle swarm algorithm(PSO) is proposed, which give the global optimal core muscle strength training prescription output parameters, namely compaction pressure and relaxation pressure. Through simulation and optimization experiments on the prescription parameters of different patients, verifying the accuracy and effectiveness of the algorithm, at the same time, the required accuracy requirements are basically satisfied.

articleTitle: Dictionary Representation Based Kernel Coupled Distance Metric Learning for Random Cross View Gait Recognition
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: This paper presents a new gait recognition approach (DR-KCDML) to enhance the recognition performance for randomly arranged unlabeled cross view gaits. Existing methods always require the label information or assume corresponding gait samples under different views originate from the same person. Our method learns original affinity between cross view samples by dictionary representation. Moreover, the gait samples of each view are mapped into a higher dimensional feature space by nonlinear mapping determined by the kernel function. Theses make DR-KCDML can preserve the obtained cross-view affinity relationship and nonlinear characteristics of original cross-view gait data. Experiments on the largest multi-view gait database, i.e., CASIA-B, show that our approach is effective against view change in gait recognition.

articleTitle: Micro-grid Power Market Bidding System Based on Multi-agent Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: For the characteristics of micro-grid power market transactions and micro-grid distributed energy, this paper uses game theory and Nash equilibrium as the theoretical basis to build a model, and uses multi-agent technology to develop a micro-grid power market bidding system. The functional modules and system architecture of each agent are described. Utilize the autonomy and coordination of Agent to provide the best bidding strategy for micro-grid for maximum profit. Finally, taking the micro-grid as the research object, the multi-agent quotation system is simulated through the JADE platform and the feasibility of the method is verified. The implementation of this method helps to avoid the blindness of the micro-grid bidding and effectively improves the micro-grid market trading economic benefits.

articleTitle: Hierarchical Management of Load and Coordinated Control of Energy in Microgrid with Multiple Distributed Generations
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: In an islanded micro-grid, due to the power supply ability of distributed generation (DG) is limited, it can not always meet the power demand of all loads at the same time in a certain period of time. Therefore, the control of load becomes extremely important. In this paper, a coordinated control structure of microgrid based on multi-agent system is proposed, and the goal of distributed coordinated control of microgrid is given. Based on this, hierarchical management of load and coordinated control of energy in the microgrid with multiple DGs is proposed. When running in the island mode, the output power of the DGs is unable to meet the load demand, the strategy can realize hierarchical management of the load, and preferentially remove load with a lower priority to ensure the normal power supply of the sensitive load; At the same time, the output power of the DGs can be adjusted in real time according to the change of the load, so that the energy intelligent optimization distribution can be realized. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy is verified by the microgrid model in the SIMULINK platform and the multi agent system simulation in the JADE platform.

articleTitle: Decoupled Active and Reactive Power Control for Asymmetric Cascade Multilevel Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: For the asymmetric cascade multi-level hybrid energy storage system based on battery and capacitor, a control method based on active/reactive decoupling is proposed. The H-bridge output voltage is decomposed into an active component parallel to the grid current and a reactive component perpendicular to the grid current. The active voltage is distributed on demand, one for DC capacitor regulation and the other for battery and grid interaction. The reactive voltage is distributed at the maximum allowable value, ensuring that the reactive component is fully distributed to each module without overmodulation. The proposed control method realizes the distribution of power between links, and ensures the stable operation of the system. Finally, the correctness and effectiveness of the method are verified by simulation.

articleTitle: SSE: A New Selective Initialization Strategy for Snapshot Ensembling
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: Deep neural network may suffer large variance in the task of small-sample classification. To overcome this problem, and motivated by that ensemble method is an effective way of reducing variance, this paper proposes a new ensemble method called Selective Snapshot Ensembling, which introduces a new selective initialization strategy into Snapshot Ensembling. Snapshot Ensembling, an ensemble method of neural networks, has been demonstrated its effectiveness on many datasets. The proposed method is able to discard some poor initializations of network parameters, and taking an example of cross-entropy loss, poor initializations here refer to those initializations which cannot make the network converge to a very small value of loss. In particular, we set a threshold of epochs in Snapshot Ensembling to monitor and select good initialization. Experimental results on two small-sample datasets, the LabelMe dataset and the 80 AI-Challeger dataset, demonstrate that the proposed ensemble method outperforms Snapshot Ensembling and other baseline methods.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Newborn Defects Prediction Based on Spark and PU-learning
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: PU-learning, whose full name is Positive and unlabeled Learning, is a machine learning method based on positive samples and unlabeled samples. In order to adapt to the demand for algorithmic improvements caused by the increasing data volume, we design and implement a distributed version of PU-learning based on Spark, and apply the algorithm to applications for newly born defective children prediction, which facilitates taking early active prevention measures. At the same time, in order to improve the prediction accuracy, we use the method of information gain to select the appropriate feature subsets, fuse the Bagging and Boosting algorithms to extend the PU-learning framework. Experiments show that the extended PU-learning framework outperforms classic PU-learning in terms of accuracy.

articleTitle: Microgrid Energy Management and Control Method Based on Two-dimensional Bidirectional Allocation Tree
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: A method of microgrid energy management and control based on two dimensional bidirectional allocation tree architecture is proposed. In this architecture, a node is added or deleted, which only affects the original node and the parent node, but does not affect the brotherhood; In addition, random energy allocation can be performed between the father and child nodes, and sequential energy allocation can be performed between the sibling nodes. This two-dimensional bidirectional deployment method can improve hit ratio of energy allocation configuration.

articleTitle: Capturing Semantic Similarity for Words in Wikipedia with Random Walk
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: As the most comprehensive and most structured Encyclopedia knowledge base that human known currently, Wikipedia has provided a great deal of semantic knowledge to people. In order to fully excavate the semantic similarity of the keywords in Wikipedia, in this paper we propose a method based on similarity of words in random walk mode. Firstly, we construct the Wikipedia link graph based on Wikipedia's structured information, and then use random walk to fully excavate the semantic relevance of Wikipedia keywords. We propose T-truncated and ε-truncated pruning strategies for improving algorithm performance. The experimental results show that the spearman series with artificial labeling standard can reach 0.51, which significantly improves the calculation results of the word correlation degree.

articleTitle: Coverage Hole Detection Algorithm Based on Cooperative Probability Coverage in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: The paper presents a new coverage hole detection algorithm based on cooperative probabilistic coverage model. By using this model, the cooperative coverage problem in monitoring areas can be transformed into distance-relationship question. The high-density and randomly scattered surveillance sensor networks can be divided into several Voronoi areas in accordance with Voronoi division method, and then the coverage of monitoring area can be judged by analyzing the distance relationship among nodes. Though the calculation of local nodes and detection of coverage of monitoring area, the coverage hole can be found. Then, by awaking some of the sleeping nodes that cover the hole area, networks can achieve the distributed coverage hole repair under the requirement of satisfying the cooperative sensing probability. Simulation results show that the coverage hole detection algorithm proposed in this paper is prior to another algorithm.

articleTitle: A Novel Method of Human Tracking Based on Stereo Vision
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: The paper presents a novel human tracking method based on stereo vision. This method works for tracking human across scene, which will combine disparity map and the size of human together to detect a person in the scene and track it. We also extend the method by not only make use of the depth information from the disparity map but also compare the difference of each disparity map pair to get the motion change information and speed information as well. Then we combine the target depth information, size information and speed information together to detect the human. Kalman Filter is used for tracking in both methods and compared the results in the experiment. The tracking results are satisfying.

articleTitle: Optimization for Demand Side Management with PAR in Smart Building
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: Buildings can be viewed as small cities due to their size, users, and mixed complex activities. Similar to that in smart grid, Demand Side Management (DSM) in micro grid plays an important role in achieving effective and reliable energy management in buildings. In this paper, in order to reduce the Peak-to-Average Ratio of energy consumption and guarantee fairness between users, we investigate fair load scheduling for DSM based on Narrowband IoT (NB-IoT) technology in smart building. Firstly, the load scheduling model based on NB-IoT is constructed. Then, considering the constraints of energy consumption, energy storage and energy generation in buildings, a minimum-maximum fair energy load scheduling problem with PAR limit is formulated into Linear Programming (LP) and solved by commercial software CPLEX. Finally, simulation results validate our proposed optimization method to achieve fair load scheduling with DSM mechanism by comparing with the case without DSM mechanism in smart building.

articleTitle: An efficient hybrid evolutionary algorithm to polymorphic TSP
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: The whole solution space of the polymorphic travelling salesman problem(PTSP) could reach up to (N!)*(2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">N</sup>) in lithography machine scan route planning, which is 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">N</sup> larger than normal TSP solution space. Here, N stands for the number of scan fields, and 2 means that it could have either plus(+) or minus(-) scan direction. Scan order and scan direction of scan fields should be determined simultaneously by solving PTSP. The challenge is that PTSP solution space expands rapidly with the increase in the number of scan fields. To find PTSP global optimal solutions more efficiently, a hybrid optimized evolutionary algorithm is proposed in this paper. Extended mathematical definitions on PTSP under different constraints are also described. Experiment results on classical 96 scan fields wafer layout are given, which shows the efficiency and improvements of our proposed algorithm compared with other algorithms listed in this paper.

articleTitle: Adaptive Neural Control of A Flexible-Joint Manipulator via Recursive Sliding-Mode Dynamic Surface Approach
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: In this paper, a recursive adaptive neural tracking control method with nonlinear gains is proposed for a flexible-joint manipulator containing unknown dynamics. A recursive sliding-mode and a nonlinear gain function are introduced in the traditional dynamic surface control method, and radial basis function (RBF) neural networks (NNs) are employed to approximate the unknown functions. A new neural network weight law with σ-modified leakage term and an adaptive law are designed to estimate the bounds of approximation errors. It is proved that the control law can guarantee the ultimate boundness of all signals in the closed-loop system. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed controller is verified by a simulation example.

articleTitle: Research on the Control of Cascade Multilevel Hybrid Energy Storage System Based on Voltage Source/Current Source
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: In the cascade hybrid energy storage system, if energy storage battery fails, an asymmetric converter based on batteries and capacitors can be formed by disconnecting the contact switch of the fault battery. A novel control method based on voltage source/current source is proposed for this asymmetric system. The battery chains can be equivalent to voltage source, and the capacitor chains can be equivalent to current source. To solve the problem of imbalance between the battery units and capacitor units, a balancing control method is applied through adding an active power voltage vector based on the hierarchical control architecture. Steady state operation area and operation region of the proposed control method are also analyzed. The correctness and validity of the method are verified by simulation.

articleTitle: The Stability Analysis of T-S Fuzzy System with Constant Time-delay
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: To study the problems of stability analysis of non-linear system with time-delay, this paper focuses on the stability analysis of T-S fuzzy system with constant time-delay. By constructing a new type of Lyapunov-Krasovskii functional and employing integral inequality method based on Legendre orthogonal polynomials, a new stability criterion with less conservatism has proposed. Numerical example is given to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Improved Phonotactic Language Recognition Using Collaborated Language Model
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: In this paper an approach to build a collaborated feature supervector is proposed and a collaborated language model (CLM) builded with binary decision tree feature surpervector and N-gram feature supervector is introduced and applied to deal with the problems of language identification tasks such as handling long term contexts and too many parameters. Experiments are carried out on the database of National Institute of Standards and Technology language recognition evaluation 2009 (NIST LRE 2009). The experimental results have confirmed that phonotactic language recognition system using the collaborated language model yields 1.07%, 2.68%, 13.48% in equal error rate (EER), which means 8.54%, 12.70% and 4.60% relative reduction for 30s, 10s, 3s compared to the baseline system, respectively.

articleTitle: Research on Differential Private Streaming Histogram Publication Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: In view of the memory limitation and irreversibility of data stream, a differential private histogram publication algorithm for data stream (ASDP-HPA) is proposed in the paper, which accounts of the differential privacy model and adaptive sampling method, combined with the autoregressive integrated moving average model and dynamical sliding window technique. Compared with traditional method of noise injection for input dataset, the algorithm effectively saves the overall privacy budget, reduces the publication error and improves the usability of the streaming histogram. The results of experiment show that adoption of dynamical sliding window gains higher memory utilization. And various selection of privacy budgets validates that the algorithm is effective and feasible with higher accuracy.

articleTitle: Networked Active Vibration Control of Structural Systems Under Network-Induced Delays
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: This paper considers networked active vibration control for structural systems with multiple degrees of freedom. For the structural system suffering from an earthquake stimulation, a networked negative velocity feedback controller (NVFC) is constructed to implement the vibration control. By considering network-induced delay, the resulting system model of the networked structural system is established as a system with a time-varying delay. A new H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> performance criterion and a controller designing scheme are derived by a complete Lyapunov-Krasovskii functional (LKF) with the partition of the delay bound. Simulation results show that the proposed design method can improve the vibration control performance and the designed networked NVFC can fulfill a superior vibration suppression effect with smaller control force.

articleTitle: Quantization control of networked interconnected control systems with decentralized event-triggered scheme
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: This paper investigates a decentralized implementation of event-triggered mechanisms for networked interconnected control systems with quantization. Firstly, we propose a decentralized event-triggered communication scheme which does not depend on the overall plant information of the system. Taking into account the time-varying delay, state and control input quantizations, and decentralized event-triggered scheme, a resulting closed-loop system is modeled as a delayed system. Sufficient LMI conditions for the uniform ultimate bounded stability analysis and quantized control synthesis are obtained. To further reduce the occupancy of the communication bandwidth, a heuristic algorithm is presented to tune the communication scheme parameters. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is illustrated by simulation results.

articleTitle: Decentralized adaptive control for time-varying formation tracking of multi-agent system
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: A decentralized adaptive control approach is developed for trajectory tracking of multi-agent formation. The system consists of multiple agents with nonlinearities and uncertainties. The agent can only get information from their neighbors. A digraph is utilized to describe the communication network among the agents. Decentralized strategy is designed since some agents can only get local information from the neighbors. Dynamic surface technique is applied to deal with nonlinear dynamics, and several tuning functions are designed to estimate the uncertainties. Stability analysis proves that the developed control scheme can form and keep the formation shape of multi-agent system while tracking the reference trajectory. Numerical simulation is given to illustrate the advantages of the control approach.

articleTitle: Biclustering of Gene Expression Data Based on Binary Artificial Fish Swarm Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: Many existing biclustering algorithms has been used to determine co-expressed genes in gene expression data under subsets of experimental conditions. The Mean Squared Residue (MSR) or the Average Correlation Value (ACV) often be employed as fitness functions. But this measure may not find some relevant genes with shifting and scaling patterns. Here we introduce a new approach - Binary Artificial Fish Swarm Algorithm (BAFSA), which possesses an improved Meta-heuristic search algorithm that combines traditional artificial fish swarm algorithm (AFSA) with binary forms. To find genes with shifting and scaling patterns, we used a fitness function based on the linear correlation. The biclustering algorithm based on BAFSA has been applied to Mice Protein Expression dataset and many biologically significant biclusters are found, which exhibited the superb performance. Then the performance of the proposed method is compared to CC, QUBIC and FLOC.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Word Embedding via Domain Keywords
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: Word embeddings, unsupervisedly learned, have proven to be very effective and provide semantic and syntactic information in most NLP tasks. Most common intrinsic evaluations of word embeddings use the similarity of words as core. Notwithstanding, these frequently correspond inadequately with how well the word embeddings perform as features in actual downstream tasks. We present VECDS (Vector Domain Score) based on the corresponding domain keywords, like high frequency or extracted by human, in downstream evaluation tasks. The domain keywords is more important for downstream than other common vocabulary.

articleTitle: Text Classification with Keywords and Co-occurred Words in Two-stream Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: In the task of text classification, the results are often affected by the sparseness of the corpus in a certain category. This paper proposed a Text classification method based on keywords and co-occurred words in two-stream neural network, in which the keywords are selected from training corpus, and the co-occurred words are chosen from external corpus, and they both are the input of the aid-stream of neural network, which is to enhance the category characteristics of representation vector in main-stream, especially for the category with less data distribution. The experiment results in Fudan University Corpus proved that the proposed method further improved the accuracy of the traditional GRU network. The proposed aid-stream based on keywords and co-occurred words is of great significance to the task of text classification and will provide method support for other natural language processing task.

articleTitle: A Graph-based Recommendation Method for the Academic Community
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: We propose an innovative approach for academic recommendation, which integrates the topic component into the graph-based recommendation. Specifically, based on the topic component extracted from the text data on academic corpus, we propose a User Behavior Graph (UBG) and the User Academic Network (UAN). UBG is a bridge to fuse topic information and UAN. A personalized PageRank (PPR) algorithm is used on UBG for recommendation. Experimental results show that our method for academic recommendation outperforms the content-based recommendation.

articleTitle: 3D Model Retrieval Based on Vision Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: By applying multi-view features of a 3D model as the whole feature descriptors to match the 3D model feature, this paper presents a modified 3D model retrieval algorithm which is based on the fusion of contour features and texture features of the model. After two-dimensional depth images of the 3D model are obtained under the different views of a spherical bounding box, the contour feature and the texture features of the model images are fused for realizing the constitute of the 3D model. The experiment results show that the proposed method gains great improvement in retrieval speed and effective rate in comparison with other view-based 3D model retrieval methods.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Sliding Mode Control of Interior Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor Based on Maximum Torque Per Ampere
publicationTitle: 2018 5th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems (CCIS)
abstract: The paper presents an adaptive sliding mode controller (ASMC) based on the maximum torque per ampere(MTPA) control, which is proposed for the speed tracking control of Interior Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor (IPMSM) servo system with external disturbance torque. In order to solve the problem, Newton-Lawson iteration method is adopted to achieve the distribution of d-q axis stator current under MTPA control. In addition, an adaptive sliding mode controller is designed for reducing the chatter and improving the stability of the servo system. The comparison of simulation results show that the proposed method effectively improves not only the dynamic and steady-state performance but also the anti-disturbance capability of the system.
